canonical_project: Microsoft Busan Data Center 2 (Miumsandan AI datacenter)
notes: Second and larger Microsoft datacenter in Busan, unveiled 23 Sep 2024 in the International Industrial Logistics City, Gangseo-gu (Miumsandan); designed to support AI-powered cloud services across Asia-Pacific. No public MW figure; part of Microsoft's multi-DC Gangseo campus. K-water signed Korea's first water-use partnership tied to Microsoft's Seoul/Busan datacenter operations in 2025.
